summary: Match references to entries across snapshot states, returning (status, namespace, location, hash).

traps.quote: a function match changes the namespace to "function"
traps.consequence: Value reference matching function incorrectly returns namespace='value'.
traps.guard: Update namespace to 'function' when value reference matches function candidate.

traps.quote: Once matched, the reference becomes location-authoritative immediately and for all later
traps.consequence: Matched reference re-matched at later snapshots; hash incorrectly updated.
traps.guard: Track matched references; skip re-matching once location-authoritative.

traps.quote: `N` is `0` or a positive decimal integer without leading zeroes
traps.consequence: Suffix @01 incorrectly parsed as valid; reference treated as valid.
traps.guard: Reject @N if N has leading zero unless N is exactly '0'.

traps.quote: prepending the longest through shortest prefix of `context` to qualified parsed name
traps.consequence: Candidates checked in wrong order; reference matches wrong entry or misses.
traps.guard: Check candidates in exact longest-to-shortest order with first-match-wins.

traps.consequence: References with start=len(snapshots) skipped if only 0..len(snapshots)-1 assumed.
traps.guard: Snapshot states span 0 to len(snapshots) inclusive, not 0 to len-1.

traps.quote: at most 200,000 snapshots, entries, updates, and references each
traps.consequence: Naive O(n²) checking every reference at every snapshot times out.
traps.guard: Use dict/set lookups for O(1) candidate existence checks per snapshot.

input_shape: Initial state, up to 200k snapshot update batches, up to 200k references with namespace, name, version.
output_shape: One tuple per reference in input order: (status, namespace, location, hash). Status is invalid, missing, or located.
invariants: Snapshots indexed 0 through len(snapshots) inclusive; len(snapshots)+1 total states.
Once a reference is location-matched, it never re-matches in later snapshots.
max_scale: 200,000 snapshots, entries, updates, references; 1,000,000 induced candidate names.
